materials: blueprint-paper: PBR set, textures/blueprint-paper_basecolor.png (sRGB), blueprint-paper_normal.png (OpenGL, +Y up, tangent space), blueprint-paper_orm.png (R occlusion, G roughness, B metal)
look: deep blue blueprint paper, base #0B2A6B to #123A8C (the style block ground), fibre and cloud variation, a faint cyan-white grid (16 cells per tile, every 4th line a little stronger, 10 to 20 percent line weight, blended 0.55 toward #BFE8FF). No wing outlines, compass rose, scale bar or text: those are drawn at runtime into a render target (art-breakdown.md element 2)
tile_size_note: one tile covers 0.5 m on a side at the intended scale; the repeat is the UE material's choice
blender: Blender 5.2.2 (CPU, Cycles for the evidence), scripts/art/materials/build_materials.bpy (bake and seam check), render_materials.bpy (evidence), write_manifests.mjs
licence: own procedural work; no generated input, no Leonardo, ComfyUI or TRELLIS
lynx_commit_note: null until the merge sets it

input.note: procedural, no generated input. Reference: art-breakdown.md element 2 (deep blue blueprint paper with a faint grid) and lookdev/style-block.json palette ground.

tiling.note: seam check on the stored PNGs, per file and per axis: wrap = mean abs difference between the first and last pixel row/column (the pair that touches when the tile repeats), inner = mean abs difference between neighbouring pixels over the tile; pass when wrap / inner <= 1.25. Worst ratio over 3 files and 2 axes: 1.0427. Method: fields are periodic by construction (FFT-filtered noise, integer stripe counts, wrapped finite differences for the normal map).
